First, subtract 5 months from 1363-01-06:  
1363-01-06 → 1362-08-06 (since January minus 5 months goes back to August of previous year).  

Then subtract 28 days from 1362-08-06:  
August 6 minus 28 days = July 9 (31 days in July, so 6 days back to July 31, then 22 more days back to July 9).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1362-07-09
